name: hud-selection
description: The selection panel for several units, in the middle of the bottom bar: a header with how many units, their hit points together and how many stand idle, then one tile per unit type with its count and a health strip, one segment per unit, healthiest first, and a red frame on a type with a unit in the red. In Big Arena the player has eight tanks, four artillery pieces and two constructors; the tanks and the artillery hold fire while three enemy tanks shoot at the front two tanks for five seconds and then drive off, so one tank is red and one amber, and the constructors walk away so the idle count leaves them out. a-three-types: fourteen selected, three tiles (tank 8 with a red frame and a strip of six green, one amber and one red, artillery 4, constructor 2), 12 idle in amber. b-tanks-only: a click on the tank tile keeps the eight tanks, one tile. c-artillery-dropped: everything selected again and a Shift-click on the artillery tile drops the four pieces, two tiles. d-twenty-eight-tanks: twenty more tanks join and all 28 are selected, more than the strip has segments for, so it shows one run per colour, the red one at the right end, and the red count of 1 in the tile's corner. e-deposit-in-selection: a Shift-click on the timber stand adds it to the 28 tanks; a deposit is not a unit, so it gets no tile and is not counted, and the panel keeps working after it (the constructors get their tile next). Then two tanks and the two constructors are selected and one tank dies: the tank tile stays first with 1, a death never reorders the tiles. f-one-left-by-death: two tanks are selected and one dies, so Groups hides and the survivor's card shows in Single. The checks read the panel: Groups shows and Single hides with several selected, Single shows the card and Groups hides with one, both hide with none; the tiles' order, names, counts and size; the tiles inside the selection panel, level with the command card's first row, clear of the minimap and the command card, with the totals line under them; the header's numbers; the strip's healthy, hurt and critical counts; the tank tile's tooltip; the red frame, resting and under the pointer, only on the tank tile. Run it at a true 1920x1080 (80 px tiles) and a true 1280x720 (64 px tiles).
